generation_rule: Sequential synthetic identifier using UGC_###### format.
purpose: Unique record identifier and traceability.
assumption_or_rationale: Each synthetic cable asset requires a unique stable identifier.
limitations: Does not correspond to any real SAPN asset identifier.

generation_rule: Sample from 60 synthetic feeders using non-uniform Dirichlet-generated feeder weights.
purpose: Provide grouping/network context for analysis and later masking experiments.
assumption_or_rationale: Feeder populations are intentionally unbalanced rather than perfectly equal.
limitations: Synthetic feeder structure; no real topology or feeder mapping is represented.

generation_rule: Random categorical sampling.
purpose: Represent common underground distribution cable voltage classes.
assumption_or_rationale: 11 kV assets are made more common than 33 kV assets for synthetic testing.
limitations: Probabilities are synthetic assumptions, not measured SAPN proportions.

generation_rule: Scaled Beta distribution, rounded and clipped to valid years.
purpose: Primary age-related field and candidate imputation target.
assumption_or_rationale: The synthetic population contains both old and recent assets, with greater density in more recent decades.
limitations: Not calibrated to SAPN installation history.

generation_rule: Deterministic derivation: 2026 - installation_year.
purpose: Derived asset age for analysis and downstream reliability examples.
assumption_or_rationale: Age is calculated using 2026 as the fixed reference year.
limitations: Directly leaks installation_year and must be excluded/masked when installation_year is an imputation target.

generation_rule: Right-skewed lognormal sampling with clipping.
parameters_or_categories: Lognormal mean=ln(165), sigma=0.65; clipped to 15-1800 m
purpose: Represent physical cable section length.
assumption_or_rationale: Cable lengths are expected to be positive and right-skewed rather than normally distributed.
limitations: Synthetic range/distribution only; not fitted to SAPN cable-length data.

generation_rule: Conditional Bernoulli sampling where PILC probability decreases for newer installation years.
purpose: Represent cable insulation technology and create a meaningful age relationship.
assumption_or_rationale: Older synthetic assets are more likely to be PILC and newer assets more likely to be XLPE.
limitations: Year thresholds and probabilities are project assumptions, not a confirmed SAPN transition history.

generation_rule: Conditional sampling based on insulation type and installation year.
parameters_or_categories: Copper/Aluminium; base P(Copper)=0.88 for PILC and 0.18 for XLPE, adjusted for very old/new assets
purpose: Represent conductor material and provide an explainable predictor relationship.
assumption_or_rationale: Older/PILC synthetic cables are more likely to use copper; newer/XLPE assets are more likely aluminium.
limitations: Synthetic relationship only and not a verified SAPN material mix.

generation_rule: Material-specific weighted categorical sampling with a voltage-based adjustment.
purpose: Represent cable conductor cross-sectional size.
assumption_or_rationale: Size distributions differ by material and are constrained to avoid some unlikely synthetic combinations.
limitations: Category weights are synthetic and require validation before any engineering interpretation.

generation_rule: Conditional Bernoulli sampling.
parameters_or_categories: 1 or 3 cores; P(1-core)=0.58 at 11 kV and 0.74 at 33 kV
purpose: Represent cable configuration.
assumption_or_rationale: Core-count probabilities are varied by voltage class to avoid complete independence between fields.
limitations: Synthetic proportions only.

generation_rule: Random categorical sampling.
purpose: Represent cable installation environment and contribute to corrosion proxy generation.
assumption_or_rationale: Both installation methods are retained, with duct/conduit more common in the synthetic population.
limitations: Synthetic proportions only; no geographic or historical calibration.

generation_rule: Sample around six approximate South Australian location centres using Gaussian offsets, then clip to broad bounds.
parameters_or_categories: Location mixture weights: Adelaide 0.82, Murray Bridge 0.04, Port Augusta 0.03, Whyalla 0.03, Port Lincoln 0.03, Mount Gambier 0.05; bounds -38.05 to -32.30
purpose: Provide synthetic spatial structure for environmental proxy generation.
assumption_or_rationale: Most synthetic assets are concentrated around Adelaide with smaller regional clusters.
limitations: Coordinates do not represent real cable locations and must not be interpreted as SAPN geospatial data.

generation_rule: Sample around six approximate South Australian location centres using Gaussian offsets, then clip to broad bounds.
parameters_or_categories: Location mixture weights as latitude; bounds 135.70 to 141.00
purpose: Provide synthetic spatial structure for environmental proxy generation.
assumption_or_rationale: Coordinates create spatial variation while remaining artificial.
limitations: Coordinates do not represent real cable locations.

generation_rule: Poisson sampling with rate increasing with cable length.
purpose: Represent cable joints and create a length-joint relationship.
assumption_or_rationale: Longer synthetic cable sections have a greater expected number of joints.
limitations: The coefficient and cap are synthetic assumptions and are not SAPN engineering rules.

generation_rule: Generate a two-point LINESTRING centred on the synthetic latitude/longitude with total route length approximately equal to cable_length_m and random bearing.
parameters_or_categories: Approximate conversion using 111,320 m per latitude degree and cosine adjustment for longitude
purpose: Provide simple route geometry for spatial experiments.
assumption_or_rationale: A minimal line geometry is sufficient for synthetic geospatial testing.
limitations: Not a surveyed route and not suitable for engineering distance or network-topology conclusions.

generation_rule: Deterministic concatenation of conductor size, core count, material code, insulation label and rated voltage.
purpose: Provide a synthetic raw descriptive field for parsing/data-quality experiments.
assumption_or_rationale: The field intentionally duplicates information available in structured columns.
limitations: Derived field; should not be treated as independent evidence when imputing its component variables.

generation_rule: Spatial synthetic function plus deterministic Gaussian noise, clipped to 0.5-15.0 m.
parameters_or_categories: Base 6.0 m; spatial sinusoidal component weighted 0.45/0.35/0.20; noise SD=1.15
purpose: Synthetic environmental proxy for groundwater conditions.
assumption_or_rationale: Spatial structure is introduced so nearby synthetic locations can have related groundwater conditions.
limitations: Not based on measured South Australian groundwater data and must be labelled synthetic.

generation_rule: Inverse scaling of groundwater depth to 0-1 plus small deterministic Gaussian noise, then clipped to 0-1.
purpose: Continuous groundwater exposure measure for imputation and validation experiments.
assumption_or_rationale: Shallower synthetic groundwater is treated as higher exposure.
limitations: Dimensionless project-defined proxy, not an established engineering index.

generation_rule: Deterministic categorisation of groundwater_exposure_score.
purpose: Human-readable category derived from the continuous exposure score.
assumption_or_rationale: Retains a simple categorical interpretation alongside the numeric score.
limitations: Thresholds are project-defined synthetic cut-offs.

generation_rule: Linear function of groundwater exposure plus installation-method adjustment and deterministic Gaussian noise, clipped to 0-1.
parameters_or_categories: 0.12 + 0.72*groundwater_score; +0.08 Direct Buried or +0.02 Duct/Conduit; noise SD=0.075
purpose: Continuous synthetic corrosion-exposure proxy.
assumption_or_rationale: Higher groundwater exposure and direct burial are assumed to increase synthetic corrosion exposure while retaining uncertainty.
limitations: Not a physical corrosion-rate model or measured corrosion data.

generation_rule: Deterministic categorisation of corrosion_exposure_score.
purpose: Human-readable corrosion exposure category.
assumption_or_rationale: Provides an explainable categorical summary of the continuous synthetic score.
limitations: Thresholds are project-defined synthetic cut-offs.
